sql: SELECT c.name AS empresa, (SELECT string_agg(u.name || CASE WHEN u.is_physical THEN '(F)' ELSE '(C)' END, ', ' ORDER BY u.sort_order) FROM company_units u WHERE u.company_id = c.id AND u.is_active) AS unidades, (SELECT string_agg(coalesce(x.unit, '-') || ':' || x.n, ' ' ORDER BY x.n DESC) FROM (SELECT l.unit, count(*) AS n FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = c.id AND l.created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1) x) AS leads_por_unidade, (SELECT string_agg(coalesce(y.unit, '-') || ':' || y.n, ' ' ORDER BY y.n DESC) FROM (SELECT e.unit, count(*) AS n FROM company_events e WHERE e.company_id = c.id AND e.created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1) y) AS festas_por_unidade, (SELECT string_agg(coalesce(z.unit, '-') || ':' || z.n, ' ' ORDER BY z.n DESC) FROM (SELECT v.unit, count(*) AS n FROM lead_visits v WHERE v.company_id = c.id AND v.created_at > now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1) z) AS visitas_por_unidade FROM companies c WHERE c.slug IN ('castelo-da-diversao', 'megamegic', 'planeta-divertido')
